input_scope: Supervisor appraisal answers only; employee self-questionnaires are context for the supervisor and are not classified or scored.

scoring_policy.positive: score contribution of 100 when direction confidence is at least 0.50 and no opposing clause evidence triggers review
scoring_policy.negative: score contribution of 0 when direction confidence is at least 0.50 and no opposing clause evidence triggers review
scoring_policy.review_policy: Low-confidence or opposing-clause results are held for supervisor review; other positive or negative results are automatic, while supervisor corrections remain optional.

historical_grouped_test.note: Earlier grouped holdout result from the supplied notebook; the exported model is refit on all labeled rows.
